Finding business-specific peers

Who competes with Alphabet in autonomous passenger transport? Who operates freight rail like Berkshire Hathaway? Compare the companies each method retrieved and inspect the filing passages behind the rankings.

What the pilot found

On ten development questions, whole-company TF-IDF returned 14 direct business matches in 100 top-ten positions. The highest-scoring BGE configuration returned 37. A simpler question-to-filing TF-IDF baseline led at rank five with 28 matches in 50 positions. The questions, cutoffs and candidate coverage matter for interpreting these figures.

Explore the rankings

How to read the results

One AI-assisted review graded each question–issuer pair as direct, adjacent or unconfirmed. A sensor supplier or a freight customer can mention the right activity while performing a different role. Business-role grades use filing evidence and occasional contemporaneous sources beyond the displayed snippets. The pilot measures retrieval relevance. Independent reviewers, held-out questions and downstream predictive tests remain outstanding.

The main corpus contains 5,449 eligible issuers with 2023 filings. The older TF-IDF index used 5,512 issuers. All its displayed whole-company top tens and question-to-filing top fives were eligible in the smaller pool. SIC is an unranked group sample. TNIC covers eight questions with 33 results. Issuers count by legal entity. External SEC links require internet access.
